evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 5.1 ppm after remaining approximately 3–6 ppm during the ramp.
Oxygen increased to 13.2 ppm during growth.
Oxygen continued rising to 27.1 ppm, following 19.4 ppm at 2880 s.
Oxygen reached 33.2 ppm, a sustained departure from the post-purge baseline.
Temperature 750.1 °C and Ar 99.9 sccm match setpoints; pressure remains near baseline at 761.0 Torr and heater power is 44.6%. These readings do not identify the source of the oxygen rise.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and a leak/inlet-gas check are needed to distinguish air ingress from gas contamination, outgassing, or oxygen-sensor error; no sample characterization is available.
